items.title: August Lanoix Interview, 1961-04-19
items.q: The interviewee mentions Teddy Wilson in a list of bands and recordings (e.g., 'Teddy Wilson played solos in the quartet') but does not describe a personal interaction, collaboration, or direct professional relationship with him.

ctx.x: He played all that. Oh, yes.

Sidney Desvinge. Sidney Desvinge. Teddy Wilson. Benny Goodwin's quartet. Let's see what else the Sidney Desvinge's band played. C.C. Rider with Myrtle Jones. And Good Morning Blues with Myrtle Jones. And I once made some records that were singing both of those numbers. Years ago, C.C. Rider, it was never issued. And Pistol Packin' Mama. And then Teddy Wilson played solos in the quartet. This other Dixieland band, I guess that was a group. Wait, no, here's Pinky on his New Orleans jazz band. Yeah, that's what I…
What do you call them, what is that?
